topic: GTA San Andreas as AI-rendered movie
new_body_text: GTA San Andreas as a movie — **rendered by one person, no studio**
new_caption:
Everyone who played San Andreas made their own movie in their head. The drive-bys at sunset. The chases through rain. The moment CJ stands over Grove Street and decides he's done running. That movie lived in the imagination of about 30 million people for two decades.

One person just rendered it. No studio, no pitch meeting, no casting call. Just AI and a very specific memory of what that game felt like at 2am on a school night.

The fact that it looks this real is impressive. The fact that it feels this right is something else entirely.

🎥 @solofimsai

Follow @metawareai for more.
